relevance_note: The paper describes one identifiable adult with HA20 ('IEI HA20') carrying a TNFAIP3 variant ('TNFAIP3 (NM_001270508.2):p.Tyr306*') who received an αβTCR/CD19-depleted allo-HSCT.
method_note: Read the whole Markdown (main text, Tables 1-2, and the Supplementary material with Tables S1-S2) and transcribed the patient rows by hand; every span was then re-checked against the paper text by regex search. Scope: only patient #9 (HA20) is in scope. The other nine patients have IEI caused by other genes (CTLA4, PIK3R1, DOCK8, FAS, ADA2, UBA1, TNFRSF13B) and no HA20/TNFAIP3 variant, so they get no rows; they are counted only in cohort_size_as_stated = 10. Label: the text's own form 'patient #9' was used (Tables 1 and 2 index patients with a bare '#' column value '9'). Table 1 'Age' is the age at allo-HSCT (mean age at allo-HSCT 32.1 in the text matches the column), so age at onset, last evaluation and diagnosis are left 'not reported'. Zygosity is left 'not reported' because the paper never states it for patient #9 (the HA20 label implies haploinsufficiency, but no zygosity is printed). vital_status 'alive' is inferred from the group statements that nine patients were alive and that the single death was patient #6. The excluded 'severe GvHD' row is inferred from a statement that names the group ('In patients #7 and #9 ... none of these patients developed severe GvHD'). Stacked cells: none affected patient #9 - the 'Pos/ Neg' Table 1 cells are patient/donor serostatus (not stacked per-patient values), and Table 2's '5/100**' is defined by the legend as first/second HSCT values; the '-' for #9 under 'At Latest Follow-up' is missing data, not a defined negative symbol, so nothing was marked 'excluded' from it. pathogenicity_as_stated_by_authors is taken from the Table S1 column heading 'Causal genetic variant' on patient #9's own row. Contradiction noticed in the paper concerns out-of-scope patients only: mixed chimerism is attributed to '#5 and #8' in the Results but to '#5 and #6' in the Discussion.
